verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs say its managed PostgreSQL offering comes with backups and PITR (point-in-time recovery). That is the product's own capability, but the evidence is a single one-line marketing mention scoped only to the dedicated Postgres engine. Nothing shows backups for TablesDB, VectorsDB, storage or self-hosted instances, and an older community thread noted backup guidance was hard to find. missing for 10: confirmation that backups are automated and on what schedule, retention and restore-window details, backup/PITR coverage for TablesDB, VectorsDB and storage, self-hosted backup tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
